Container.Name: supertonic3-tts-german-wyoming
Container.Requires: linux/amd64 and Unraid Docker. Internet for the first model/voice download. Persistent folders must allow UID/GID 99:100 to read and write. Use only on a trusted network.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: tts text-to-speech german deutsch supertonic home assistant wyoming voice
Container.Overview:
Local German text-to-speech for Home Assistant using Supertonic 3, native Wyoming integration and an optimized Rust/ONNX Runtime backend. Optimized and tested on Intel N100. Includes 10 voices, custom voice support, German text normalization and low-latency phrase streaming.
First start downloads missing models and voices into the persistent folders. Existing files remain available after updates. Streaming is optional; turn it off for full-text synthesis. Audio is 44100 Hz, mono PCM16. Connect Home Assistant to the Wyoming port; HTTP provides health and voice information. Before installation, choose unused host ports and ensure both folders are writable by UID/GID 99:100.

Config.Name: Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Free host TCP port for the Home Assistant Wyoming integration. Container port normally stays 10200.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Free host TCP port for health and voice information. This is not the Home Assistant Wyoming port.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Persistent model storage. Only missing files download. Folder must be writable by UID/GID 99:100.

Config.Name: Voices
Config.Description: Persistent standard and custom voices. Add compatible JSON files here and restart. Folder must be writable by UID/GID 99:100.

Config.Name: Default Voice
Config.Description: Choose F1–F5, M1–M5, or the filename of an installed custom JSON voice without .json.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Default German (de). German regional language codes are also accepted.

Config.Name: Speed
Config.Description: Speaking speed: 1.0 is normal; smaller values are slower. Allowed range 0.25–4.0.

Config.Name: Steps
Config.Description: Speech generation steps, 5–12. Recommended Intel N100 setting: 6. More steps require more time.

Config.Name: Threads
Config.Description: CPU threads used for speech generation. Recommended for Intel N100: 4.

Config.Name: German Normalization
Config.Description: Read German numbers, temperatures, times and units naturally. Set false to disable.

Config.Name: Streaming
Config.Description: Start sending completed phrases early. Set false for complete-text synthesis. Actual playback timing also depends on Home Assistant.

Config.Name: Streaming Prefill (ms)
Config.Description: Audio to prepare before sending the first block. Recommended: 3500 milliseconds. Allowed: 0–5000.

Config.Name: Concurrent Requests
Config.Description: Simultaneous speech requests. Recommended: 1. Larger values use more memory.

Config.Name: Model Directory
Config.Description: Keep aligned with persistent container model path

Config.Name: Voice Directory
Config.Description: Keep aligned with persistent container voice path

Config.Name: ORT Configured
Config.Description: Preserve upstream engine unless deliberately tuning

Config.Name: ORT Thread Pool
Config.Description: global or session; legacy wrapper requires global

Config.Name: ORT Inter-op Threads
Config.Description: ONNX inter-op threads

Config.Name: ORT Spinning
Config.Description: Keep disabled for tested N100 configuration

Config.Name: ORT Execution Mode
Config.Description: parallel requires ORT_CONFIGURED=true

Config.Name: Optimized Datapath
Config.Description: Bounded audio conversion and output

Config.Name: Buffered TCP
Config.Description: Buffered writes and TCP_NODELAY

Config.Name: AudioChunk Bytes
Config.Description: Even value from 512 to 262144

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Rust tracing filter

Config.Name: Container Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Match internal target of the Wyoming port mapping

Config.Name: Container HTTP Port
Config.Description: Match internal target of the HTTP port mapping
